c74object.name: el.flanjah~
c74object.digest: Dual-delay flanger with independent sinusoidal LFO modulation
c74object.description:
el.flanjah~ is a dual-delay flanger featuring two recirculating feedback loops modulated by independent sinusoidal LFOs running at different speeds. The two cascaded delay lines create rich, animated comb-filtering and flanging effects. All modulation parameters (feedback, LFO speeds, and modulation depth) can be adjusted with float messages or modulated continuously at audio rate via signal inputs.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Audio input to be flanged, and control message inlet (protect, mute, report).
Inlet 2 (signal / float): Feedback gain coefficient.
Inlet 3 (signal / float): Modulation speed for LFO 1 in Hertz.
Inlet 4 (signal / float): Modulation speed for LFO 2 in Hertz.
Inlet 5 [Right Inlet] (signal / float): Delay modulation depth (0.0001 to 1.0).
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Flanged audio output signal.

inlet.description: The audio signal to be processed, as well as control messages (protect, mute, report).
Feedback amount for the delay lines.
Modulation frequency for the first LFO in Hertz.
Modulation frequency for the second LFO in Hertz.
Delay modulation depth scaling factor (clamped between 0.0001 and 1.0).

objarg.name: max-delay
objarg.description: Maximum delay buffer size in milliseconds (default: 50.0 ms, range: 0.1 to 360,000 ms).

objarg.name: speed1
objarg.description: Modulation speed for the first LFO in Hertz (default: 0.136 Hz).

objarg.name: speed2
objarg.description: Modulation speed for the second LFO in Hertz (default: 0.183 Hz).

method.name: float
method.description: Float sent to inlet 2 sets feedback. Float sent to inlet 3 sets LFO 1 speed. Float sent to inlet 4 sets LFO 2 speed. Float sent to inlet 5 sets modulation depth.

method.name: int
method.description: Converted to float and sets the parameter for the targeted inlet.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence. When set to 0 (default), normal flanging resumes.

method.name: protect
method.description: When set to 1 (default), feedback levels are automatically clamped within ±0.425 to prevent runaway oscillation and overflow. When set to 0, feedback limiting is disabled.

method.name: report
method.description: Prints current values of feedback, depth, speeds, and oscillator phases to the Max Console.

method.name: signal
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 is the audio to process. Signals connected to inlets 2 through 5 modulate feedback, speed 1, speed 2, and depth at audio rate.
